verdict_reason: Template matches the routing proxy's signed-in layout as the AC asks and uses govukSummaryList correctly, but its h1 duplicates the title string the controller passes to base().

todos.issue: The page heading 'Signed in' has two homes: hard-coded in the h1 here (line 6) and passed again as the title in src/server/auth/idm-sign-in.js showSignedIn (base('Signed in')). Every other page in the app renders its h1 from context ({{ copy.title }}, {{ heading }}, {{ sharedCopy.unauthorised.heading }}); a change to one copy leaves the browser title and the h1 disagreeing. idm-sign-in.njk and idm-signed-out.njk repeat the same pattern.
todos.fix:
Must: the signed-in page's heading and its page title come from one value, as on the app's other pages. One way: pass heading (or reuse pageTitle) from showSignedIn and render

{{ heading }}

; do the same for idm-sign-in.njk and idm-signed-out.njk.
